title: FALCA: Falsification-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Deep Search Agents
title_zh: FALCA：面向长程深度搜索智能体的证伪感知分层信用分配强化学习

paragraphs.en: 总结：FALCA提出证伪感知的搜索者-证伪者协同架构与分层信用分配强化学习，显著提升长程深度搜索智能体的表现。 Long-horizon deep search requires LLM agents to iteratively decompose complex information needs, gather evidence from external sources, and maintain a reliable research state under multiple constraints. A central challenge is that early mistakes can be amplified over the search trajectory: agents may anchor on an incorrect candidate, collect partially supporting evidence, overlook contradictions, and accumulate errors that misguide subsequent reasoning. We propose FALCA, a falsification-aware framework that formulates deep search as a propose-falsify process. FALCA adopts a collaborative Searcher-Falsifier architecture, where the Searcher proposes candidate answers or sub-answers, while independent Falsifiers actively seek counterevidence, check unmet constraints, identify conflicts, and produce concise falsification reports for research-state revision. To strengthen this loop, we introduce falsification-aware training, combining SFT warmup on falsification trajectories with agentic RL based on parallel rollouts and hierarchical credit assignment over research stages, state transitions, and actions. Experiments on five search benchmarks show that FALCA improves long-horizon deep search performance over backbone and harness ablations, while reducing confirmation bias and error accumulation through more effective falsification and research-state revision.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：FALCA提出证伪感知的搜索者-证伪者协同架构与分层信用分配强化学习，显著提升长程深度搜索智能体的表现。 长程深度搜索要求大语言模型智能体迭代地分解复杂的信息需求，从外部来源收集证据，并在多重约束下维护可靠的研究状态。 一个核心挑战在于早期错误会在搜索轨迹中不断放大：智能体可能锚定于错误的候选答案，收集部分支持的证据，忽视矛盾之处，并累积误导后续推理的错误。 我们提出FALCA，这是一个证伪感知的框架，将深度搜索形式化为一个提出-证伪的过程。 FALCA采用搜索者-证伪者协同架构，其中搜索者提出候选答案或子答案，而独立的证伪者则主动寻找反证、检查未满足的约束、识别冲突，并生成简明的证伪报告以用于研究状态的修订。 为强化这一循环，我们引入证伪感知训练，将对证伪轨迹的SFT预热与基于并行 rollout 的智能体强化学习相结合，并在研究阶段、状态转移和动作上进行分层信用分配。 在五个搜索基准上的实验表明，FALCA相较于骨干模型和工具框架消融版本提升了长程深度搜索性能，同时通过更有效的证伪和研究状态修订，减少了确认偏误与错误累积。
